pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Covered in heavy black armor, the Stone-Devouring Tortoise draws nourishment from rock and mineral essence. Though slow-moving, its defenses are formidable. It can be found upon exposed mountain summits or deep within lightless caverns, where its shell resembles ordinary stone.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found in stony and jagged peaks or dripstone caves. Requires open sky above Y=100, or zero skylight below Y=40, with stone, deepslate, tuff, calcite, gravel, or terracotta beneath it.
